title.value: An Online Newton’s Method for Time-varying Linear Equality Constraints
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the research focus on developing an online Newton's method tailored for optimization problems with time-varying constraints.
title.quote: An Online Newton’s Method for Time-varying Linear Equality Constraints

extractions.description: This paper presents the Online Projected Equality-constrained Newton Method (OPEN-M), which addresses online optimization problems with time-varying linear equality constraints. It aims to achieve sublinear dynamic regret and constraint violation bounds, outperforming existing algorithms in applications like network flow control.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on optimization algorithm development, particularly in handling time-varying constraints. Although there is a mention of a network flow application related to electric grids, the central theme revolves around mathematical and computational methodologies rather than sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We propose the Online Pro-jected Equality-constrained Newton Method (OPEN-M) to tackle this family of problems. We obtain sublinear dynamic regret and constraint violation bounds for OPEN-M under mild conditions.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on mathematical optimization techniques rather than directly addressing sustainability goals.
primary_category.quote: We propose the Online Pro-jected Equality-constrained Newton Method (OPEN-M) to tackle this family of problems.
